explanation: The article, of what the invasion left behind: "More serious for the post-war state of Iraq was the looting of cached weaponry and ordnance which fueled the subsequent insurgency. As many as 250,000 tons of explosives were unaccounted for by October 2004." `enabled` and not `caused`: what the article puts on the invasion is the means — the unguarded depots — and not the motive. The same article makes the same kind of claim about the force level, which "proved to be short-sighted ... due to the requirement for a much larger force to combat the irregular Iraqi forces in the Iraqi insurgency". Probable: Wikipedia alone.
